schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).
compiler: ccv0 (2026-11-23, all 26 modules with shrink.sh: 235 of 385 functions exact; 160 with the stubs only, 130 without the step)
binary: /bin/ex (links: vi, view, edit); E711, text 63488 bytes (code to 0xf7fe)
build: vi.mk of Plexus: mkstr - ex2.13strings x FILE.c, cc -E | xstr -c -, cc -c x.c. WEGA adds a step between the compiler and cas (src/cmd/ex/shrink.sh, cc -S, shrink.sh x.s, cas), both parts to save room (the code ends at 0xf7fe, the text limit is 64K): (1) each module begins with a table of 'jp _name' for every external function called 3 times or more (callr) in the module, the calls go by calr to the table; order 'sort | uniq -c | sort -n' (by the number of calls, then the name, ASCII); 22 tables, 183 stubs, 944 calls, 1156 bytes saved; only in ex (all programs of the root scanned). (2) a frame operand at offset 0 becomes @fp: ~L1(fp) in a function with '~L1 := 0' (not lda), and 0(fp) beside r0..r7 (the parameter stores); the saves of r8..r14 stay 0(fp) (139 of 139). Measured on the ccv0 output of all modules: 98 of 98 parameter stores and about 220 operands in the bodies as in the original. Of 310 files of the root only ex (and its links) has saves at 0(r15) with parameters at @r15. Not documented.
open: listchar, normchar (ex_put): two pairs with the same text in the .s come out differently in the original (ld r1,0(r15) and ld r1,@r15), the spills ld ~L1(fp),r2 there stay 0(r15): no text rule gives it; kept for phase B (owner 2026-11-23). setjmp.h missing in WEGA (measured with setret.h, ret_buf).
